Hi everyone

Instats is offering a new 3-day seminar by professor Tom Snijders on Longitudinal Social Network Analysis, running Feb 18 - 20. This three-day event by one of the world's leading social research methodologists provides an introductory overview of longitudinal social network analysis using the RSiena package for R, focusing on the application of the Stochastic Actor-Oriented Model (SAOM) to study network dynamics and the co-evolution of networks and behavior. Participants will gain practical skills in modeling network panel data, as well as modeling the co-evolution of networks and behavior, for application of these techniques across various academic disciplines.

Sign up today to secure your spot, and please feel free to tell your colleagues and students about this unique opportunity!


Best wishes

Michael Zyphur
